cases.lesson: Do not infer an unmatched end from a nearby block; audit whole-source block structure.
A missing terminator is a structural defect and must be revalidated after repair.

cases.wrong:
local function f()
  task.spawn(function()
    print(1)
end
cases.right:
local function f()
  task.spawn(function()
    print(1)
  end)
end
cases.lesson: Nested callback composition requires whole-source balancing after generation.
Generated formatting must not accidentally comment out executable source.
